##### Project general facts

Westwood Grande by Imtiaz is a French architectural wonder, meticulously designed by an award-winning French architect to exude elegance and flair at every turn. Its facade is conceptualised as a string of balconies arranged in a distinct wavy pattern, with soft edges that traverse in and out of the building to create a truly captivating visual spectacle. The collection offers a refined selection of studios, one bedroom apartments and sophisticated master suites, each with spacious living areas, gourmet kitchens and luxe finishes that deliver a five-star premium experience.

Residents enjoy an array of five-star amenities crafted for wellness and togetherness, headlined by a spectacular rooftop infinity pool with breath-taking views. A luxury rooftop gym powered by the latest equipment and beautifully appointed interiors makes staying active a genuine pleasure, while lush green gardens offer the perfect landscape to unwind after a long day or start the morning with a positive mindset. An open BBQ area surrounded by greenery is ideal for entertaining friends and family, and a state-of-the-art kids play area gives children a safe, social space of their own.

The interiors are curated by an award-winning interior designer to deliver an elegant, sophisticated living space with the perfect touch of luxury and opulence. Colour schemes are inspired by nature for a tranquil and calming atmosphere, layering warm wood veneer, richly veined marble surfaces, textured wall coverings and refined rose gold accents throughout. Every home is equipped with highly reliable Bosch appliances, timeless Villeroy & Boch sanitary fittings and Legrand smart switches, complemented by keyless entry smart locks, Alexa home automation and remote climate control for a seamless everyday experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
